alerts.title: Night curfew at Republique and Les Halles
alerts.body: Curfew 11pm-6am through Mon Oct 26 6am. Fine 135 EUR. ID checks possible. Republique, Chatelet and Les Halles metro stations close 10pm on curfew nights.

alerts.title: US Embassy security alert
alerts.body: Demonstrations expected; avoid large gatherings and monitor local media.

alerts.title: National union strike day
alerts.body: Union strike call including rail unions. Paris march gathers at Republique, ends at Nation; route TBA. Expect transit disruption.
